name: Aly Gonzales / AGENCY818
summary: Pink, cream and serif. Single-take talking heads, no music, a different graphic treatment on every beat. Everything on screen is made with CapCut's own fonts, text animations and sound effects.

captions.template: 3-4 words per line, serif, white, pink highlight on the spoken word

sounds.note: Names of CapCut sound effects, exactly as they appear in your sound kit. One per visible event, under the voice.

pacing.punchInRule: Alternate at sentence ends only, and only when Claude does the cut.

rules: CapCut only: every font, text animation and sound comes from CapCut's own library.
Vary the mix: every beat gets a different treatment, never the same graphic type twice in a row.
Retakes: when the same idea is said twice, keep only the last take.
On-screen hook text never repeats a line said later in the video.
If the clip was trimmed by hand, the cuts are final. Only add graphics, sound and captions.
Graphics appear on a spoken word, never in silence. No title-only pop-ins.
Text stays off the face: cards above the head, big text on the chest, captions low.
No em dashes in on-screen text. Use the speaker's own words.
One sound per visible event, under the voice. No music bed on talking heads.
Export from CapCut at the recorded resolution and frame rate.
sources: Seeded from the approved talking-head edits. Fonts are the closest CapCut matches to Instrument Serif, Inter, Caveat, Dancing Script, Fredoka and Anton.
Run the inspo review on Desktop/claude to edit/03 inspo to refresh this sheet.
